In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a '''battle''' took place near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teptixii]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] between the [[Task Force Admonitor|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] and elements of [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|navy]]. After the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], under the command of Captain [[Calo Drusan]], came to Parck's assistance, Esva's forces fled to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="CoO" />
